svg.title: The four ways a run ends, and which one is planned
svg.desc: A single box on the left represents the agent loop. Four arrows leave it, one to each of four outcomes. First, the model declares completion and the run ends as a success. Second, your step cap fires and the run ends, and no standard field records that the cap fired, so the record does not separate this outcome from the first. Third, a check fails, the tripwire halts the run, and a person has to clear it because the run does not resume by itself. Fourth, highlighted, the design says pause: the run parks, a person approves, edits or rejects, and the run resumes from where it stopped. Only the fourth is planned and only the fourth resumes.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: The four ways a run ends

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Three of them stop the run for good. One of them is planned, and resumes.
